main_text.head: DE INJURIIS.
TITULUS IV.
main_text.p: [?]rtum delictum privatum est injuria, de qua hoc titulo tractatur. Dividitur autem hic tit. in sex partes.

page.notes: The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page with faint fragments of text and of the axiom numbers (such as "I." and "II."). These are cut off by the scan edge and were not transcribed; the first letters of several axioms are therefore uncertain. The opening word of the first paragraph may be incomplete on the scan. The woodcut initial is hard to read; the first letter is given as G with [?]. The Greek words ὕβριν and ἀδίκημα are copied as seen but may need checking. The catchword "mnum" continues the hyphenated word "da-" from the last line.
